documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Amal Ltd reported a significant increase in consolidated and standalone sales for FY2025-26, driven primarily by a 164% spike in the price of Sulphur, its main raw material. However, profit before tax declined due to the inability to fully absorb these increased input costs. The company remains debt-free with an increased cash surplus and has recommended a higher dividend of 15%. Amal is currently implementing three capex projects and evaluating two growth projects while maintaining its focus on operational efficiency and capacity utilization. Amal Ltd reported its best consolidated results for FY 2024-25, with sales increasing by 57% to Rs 135 cr and PBT increasing 11 times to Rs 33 cr.

guidance.claim: The company has three key objectives to strengthen itself further, including upgrading its existing manufacturing facility, expanding selected products, and strengthening the leadership team.
guidance.quote: At this time, we have three key objectives to strengthen our Company further: • One, to invest in upgrading the existing manufacturing facility – two CapEx proposals of ` 6 cr are underway. • Two, to expand (selected existing products) and add new related products. • Three, to further strengthen the leadership team to secure future growth.

demand_outlook.quote: Both markets are growing at about 3% per annum.

demand_outlook.quote: The main contributors were higher price realisation and capacity utilisation.
